caseName: Missouri Pacific R. R. v. Nebraska State Ry. Comm'n
caseNameFull: Missouri Pacific R. R. Corp'n v. Nebraska State Ry. Comm'n
attorneys: Messrs. Anan Raymond and Charles F. McLaughlin, with whom Messrs. J. A. C. Kennedy, Francis A. Brogan, Alfred. G. Ellick, and E. J. White were on the brief, for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Hugh La Master, with whom Mr. O. S. Spillman was on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The writ of error is dismissed for want of a properly presented substantial federal question, on the authority of St. Louis & San Francisco R. R. v. Sheppard, 240 U. S. 240; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. City of Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1; Consolidated Turnpike Co. v. Norfolk & Ocean View Ry., 228 U. S. 326.
